tools.name: list_rooms

available_by.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only rooms whose available_from is on or before this date.

area.description: City (Durham, Raleigh, Chapel Hill) or 5-digit ZIP.

tools.description: List rooms in the inventory. Filter by the date a room must be free by and/or by area (city or ZIP).

tools.name: get_room
tools.description: Get the full record for one room: rent, deposit, utilities, availability, pets, lease minimum, occupancy cap, amenities, photos.

tools.name: update_room
tools.description: Change fields on a room record, for example a new rent or available_from the owner gave you. Do this BEFORE quoting a new price anywhere.

tools.name: create_listing

price.description: Monthly rent in USD; must equal the room record's rent.

tools.description: Create a draft listing for a room. The price must equal the room's rent and any dollar figure in the text must come from the room record. Returns the draft plus compliance findings.

tools.name: publish_listing

channel.description: One of marketplace, roomies, craigslist, padsplit.

tools.description: Post a draft or live listing to one channel. Call once per channel. Refused if the listing text fails the fair-housing check.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Edit a listing's title, body or price. Live posts are updated too.

tools.name: mark_filled
tools.description: Mark a listing filled; removes it from every channel. Use when a room is leased.

tools.name: get_listing_media
tools.description: Get the photo names and URLs for a room, to attach to listings or messages.

tools.name: check_listing_compliance
tools.description: Check ad or message text against fair-housing advertising rules (24 CFR 100.75). Returns findings with a suggested rewrite for each problem phrase.

tools.name: get_market_rent

bedrooms.description: Optional; ZORI is all-sizes, so this is recorded but does not change the number.

tools.description: Get the Zillow Observed Rent Index (typical whole-home rent) for a ZIP. A room in a shared home normally rents well below this.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List conversation threads with renters (summaries). Use unanswered_only to find threads whose last message is from the renter.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read every message in one thread.

tools.name: send_message

thread_id.description: Plain, short text in the renter's language.

text.description: Plain, short text in the renter's language.

items.description: Plain, short text in the renter's language.

tools.description: Send a reply in a thread. Style rules are enforced: at most 2 sentences, at most one question, no em or en dashes, and no dollar figure or lease term that is not in the room or listing record. Ask for one missing item at a time.

tools.name: read_reply

thread_id.description: Raw message text, when there is no thread.

text.description: Raw message text, when there is no thread.

pending_item.description: The item you last asked for, so a bare 'yes' or '2' is read correctly.

tools.description: Read a renter's latest message into exact JSON: lease answer, move-in date (exact or vague), phone, occupants, reason, intents, language. Always use this instead of judging a reply yourself; a month or 'soon' is vague, not a date.

tools.name: upsert_renter
tools.description: Create or update the renter record for a thread. Put gate answers from read_reply under fields.gate (lease, move_in, phone, occupants, reason) and preferences under fields.wants.

tools.name: match_renters
tools.description: Rank renters in the register for a room by budget, area, move-in date, occupancy and gate completeness.

tools.name: find_showing_slots
tools.description: Find free showing slots for a room within showing hours, between two dates (max 14 days).

tools.name: propose_showing
tools.description: Propose a showing time to a renter. Refused unless the renter's gate is complete: explicit yes to a 12-month lease, an exact move-in date, phone, reason and number of occupants.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web (sandbox: local vendor directory). Returns titles, URLs and snippets.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch the text of a web page found by web_search.

tools.name: find_vendors
tools.description: Find service vendors by trade (plumber, hvac, electrician) that serve a ZIP.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask a vendor for a quote on a job. Returns TIMEOUT if the vendor does not respond; then try another vendor.

tools.name: book_vendor
tools.description: Accept a quote and book the vendor. Refused with BUDGET_EXCEEDED above the owner's spending limit; escalate those instead.

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Open a maintenance job for a property before asking vendors for quotes.

tools.name: escalate_to_owner

reason.description: The thread_id, job_id, renter_id, listing_id or quote_id the decision is about.

ref_id.description: The thread_id, job_id, renter_id, listing_id or quote_id the decision is about.

draft.description: The thread_id, job_id, renter_id, listing_id or quote_id the decision is about.

tools.description: Hand a decision to the owner (over-budget quote, shorter lease request, conditional answer, anything you may not decide). Include a draft reply when useful.

tools.name: report_to_owner
tools.description: Send the owner a short status summary of what you did.
